Ahmedabad.explanation:
👍 Ahmedabad — SUITABLE
  Solar Potential : offers good solar irradiance potential (annual mean 5.29 kWh/m²/day).
  Reliability     : Solar generation is highly consistent across all seasons (Reliability Score 76.5/100 — Consistent Producer).
  Confidence      : Model accuracy is moderate (RMSE 1.773, MAPE 29.5%); apply a 15% safety margin to system sizing estimates.
  Low-GHI risk    : Low-generation periods (P10 = 3.49 kWh/m²/day) will require supplementary grid or storage support.
  Action          : Solar investment is viable. Minor caveats on seasonal reliability or prediction uncertainty should be incorporated into system sizing. A standard grid-tie system is appropriate.
